meta.title: Equilibrium League Blessing Picker
meta.description: Set a title, pick your blessings, screenshot, and share
meta.ogImageAlt: A Selection of Blessings for RS3 Equilibrium League.

toolTipItems: Maximum adrenaline is increased by 50%.
Adrenaline generation is increased by 50%.
Maximum life points are increased by 50%.
All damage you deal gains 5% of your maximum life points as bonus damage.
Your base ability damage is increased by 25% of your total armour value.
If you are wielding a defender, it is increased by 50%.
If you are wielding a shield, it is increased by 75%.
Base health regeneration rate is increased by 2.5% of your maximum life points.
If you are wielding a defender, it is increased by 5%.
If you are wielding a shield, it is increased by 7.5%.
On hit: Your attacks deal 15% of ability damage as bonus damage.
On hit: Your attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an Inferno of Zamorak, which deals 100-200% ability damage to a single target.
Incoming damage is reduced by 10% of your armour value.
After Barkscales reduces damage 5 times, unleash a Grasp of Guthix at your attacker's location, which deals poison damage equal to 80-120% of your ability damage in a 3x3 area.
Your basic attack's damage is increased by 40%.
Your basic attacks unleash a Light of Saradomin on your target, which has a 9 second cooldown and deals damage equal to 40-60% of your ability damage, plus 250% of your armour value.
On-attack: 5% chance to activate Avernic Rampage for 7.2 seconds, causing abilities and weapon special attacks, besides the granite maul's, to use no adrenaline.
Food is no longer consumed when eaten.
You no longer lose adrenaline when eating.
Bash: Deals additional damage equal to 350-450% of your armour value.
Preparation: On activation, reduces the cooldown of all abilities by 12 seconds.
Reflect: Reflect 100% of incoming damage and 10-15% of your armour value as additional damage. Reflected damage hits up to 8 additional targets in front of you.
Revenge: The duration and cooldown of this ability is doubled. The maximum number of stacks is increased to 20.
Your accuracy is always calculated using your target's weakness.
Area of effect and multi-target attacks deal 30% more damage.
Area of effect abilities deal 5% more damage per tile the target occupies.
Melee, Magic, Ranged, and Necromancy ability and special attack cooldowns are reduced by 30%.
Your damage is increased by 20%.
Your maximum life points are reduced by 25%.
Your armour value is reduced by 25%.
For each unique Blessing path you have chosen, gain:
75 base ability damage.
50 armour.
500 life points.
5% critical strike chance.
7.5% critical strike damage.
5 Prayer bonus.
Choosing the same Blessing path (e.g. Chaos) for tier 1 to 6 applies this buff once.
Choosing a mixture of 2 Blessing paths (e.g. Chaos and Balance) from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff twice.
Choosing a mixture of 3 Blessing paths (Chaos, Balance, and Order) from tier 1 to 6 applies this buff 3 times.
Your base ability damage is increased by 30%.
You lose access to the Berserk, Death's Swiftness, Living Death, and Sunshine abilities.
Gain 15% critical strike chance.
Your critical strike chance is capped at 50%.
All excess critical strike chance is converted into critical strike damage at a 1:1 ratio.
Inferno of Zamorak gains 50% critical strike damage.
On critical strike, unleash an Inferno of Zamorak.
Damage over time abilities last 100% longer.
Every 5th hit of a damage over time ability triggers a Grasp of Guthix.
Grasp of Guthix deals additional damage equal to 20-30% of your maximum life points.
Grasp of Guthix deals poison damage equal to 80-120% of your ability damage, in a 3x3 area.
Your basic attacks triggers Light of Saradomin 5x at random tiles near your target, each damaging up to 8 targets within 1 tile.
This has a 14.4 second cooldown.
Light of Saradomin deals 2% increased damage for each point of Prayer bonus you have.
Light of Saradomin now heals you for 5% of damage dealt.
Inferno of Zamorak activation chance increased by 5x.
Grasp of Guthix activation requirement is reduced to 2.
Light of Saradomin cooldown is reduced to 4.8 seconds.
Poison damage is increased by 50%, plus an additional 2% per Herblore level.
Damaging an enemy disables their poison immunity for 30 seconds.
Generate 6% adrenaline every 1.2 seconds.
Each combat equipment item counts as 2 additional pieces towards its set effect.
Stores up to 20 weapon or armour gizmos, granting their effects while wearing augmented equipment.
Combat perks in stored gizmos have their rank doubled, excluding perks that do not benefit from additional ranks.
Your equipped weapons are treated as tier 120.
